summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests the medicine MK-2010, given alone or with other treatments, in people with advanced solid tumors. MK-2010 is given as an intravenous infusion, and the dosing schedule is not stated, while some study arms also receive pembrolizumab, chemotherapy, or oral belzutifan. The study measures safety and tolerability, and how many participants have their cancer shrink or go away (response).
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa el medicamento MK-2010, administrado solo o con otros tratamientos, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados. MK-2010 se administra por infusión intravenosa, y el calendario de dosis no se indica; algunos grupos también reciben pembrolizumab, quimioterapia o belzutifan oral. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerancia, y cuántos participantes tienen una reducción o desaparición del cáncer (respuesta).
who_for: Has radiographically measurable disease per protocol.
Has well-controlled HIV on antiretroviral therapy, if diagnosed with HIV.
Has adequate organ function per protocol.
If receiving oral treatment, can swallow and keep down oral medication without absorption-altering gastrointestinal problems.
not_for: History of Kaposi's sarcoma or multicentric Castleman's disease, if diagnosed with HIV.
History of PRES or a seizure disorder.
Hepatic encephalopathy, hepatorenal syndrome, or Child-Pugh class B or worse cirrhosis.
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Current anticoagulant use, severe heart or blood vessel disease, myocarditis, cardiomyopathy, or inflammatory bowel disease.
